ranking.within_cohort: For each metric, (mean reference - mean method) / max(abs(mean reference), normalization_floor), averaging the six prescribed cohort decisions before division.
ranking.primary: Descending equal-weight average over the four cohorts and four normalized native loss metrics.
ties: Ascending cohort-macro mean released moved fraction
Ascending cohort-macro mean complete decision CPU
ranking.reporting: Report every configuration, every cohort and native metric, admission, released movement, proposal/Selection/Audit/complete timing and overshoot. All outcomes include rejected-action incumbent fallbacks; there are no significance claims.

scope: Development targets end at or before264. No formal evaluation target or result is read. Only CARA residual width and frontier allocation/engine vary; baseline parameters remain unchanged. The adopted family executor and structural cost guard are inherited unchanged from the selected base configuration.
